label: SC-45(2)
title: Secondary Authoritative Time Source

children.label: (a)
children.prose: Identify a secondary authoritative time source that is in a different geographic region than the primary authoritative time source; and

children.label: (b)
children.prose: Synchronize the internal system clocks to the secondary authoritative time source if the primary authoritative time source is unavailable.

guidance: It may be necessary to employ geolocation information to determine that the secondary authoritative time source is in a different geographic region.
